ValidationRule.description: Complete the processing result or error details; point totals cannot be negative.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the processing result or error details; point totals cannot be negative.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(Processing_Status__c, "Processed"), OR(ISBLANK(Processed_At__c), ISBLANK(Base_Fuel_Points__c), ISBLANK(Base_Other_Points__c), ISBLANK(Campaign_Points__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Processing_Status__c, "Error"), ISBLANK(Processing_Error__c)), Base_Fuel_Points__c < 0, Base_Other_Points__c < 0, Campaign_Points__c < 0)
